name: Accordion
description: Base UI-backed accordion with shadcn/ui composition: Accordion, AccordionItem, AccordionTrigger and AccordionContent. Supports single or multiple expansion and controlled or uncontrolled values.

figma.notes: Extracted from the maintained ProductDetailPage DetailDisclosure. No independently verified Figma component binding.

children.description: AccordionItem children composed with AccordionTrigger and AccordionContent.

multiple.description: Allows multiple items to remain open.

value.description: Controlled values of the expanded items.

defaultValue.description: Initially expanded items in uncontrolled mode.

onValueChange.description: Requests expansion changes; update value when controlled. details.cancel() cancels the change.

disabled.description: Disables interaction for the entire group.

keepMounted.description: Keeps closed panel content mounted to retain child state.

hiddenUntilFound.description: Allows browser find-in-page to find and expand collapsed content.

disabled.note: Transparent background with text-disabled for text and icons; no opacity.

color.note: Neutral semantic text and divider colors; blue is reserved for keyboard focus.

type.note: GT Walsheim/native CJK stack through font-family-ios.

target.note: Retains the existing minimum 44px Web trigger; does not claim native Android 48dp compliance.

accessibility.role: native heading/button with a named region
accessibility.ariaPattern: aria-expanded and aria-controls on the native button; aria-labelledby and hidden on the panel.
accessibility.notes: Disabled triggers use native disabled with transparent backgrounds. Closed panels leave the focus order and accessibility tree. Set keepMounted to retain child state. Trigger includes an h3 Header; labels must not contain interactive children.

testing.rationale: Story play tests exercise single and multiple expansion, Enter/Space/Tab, focus styles, ID associations, controlled updates/refused updates, disabled activation, hidden-content focus and narrow content.
